item.title: Jamychal Buckner Runs Wild in South Pitt’s State Title Game Victory
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) South Pittsburg has added another gold ball to their collection. The Pirates beat McKenzie 42-14 on Friday afternoon at Finley Stadium to claim the 1A state crown. South Pitt was up 35-0 at halftime. Jamychal Buckner was named the game’s MVP after running for over 200-yards in the victory. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Heritage Pulls Away to Beat NW Whitfield 45-26
item.description: Tunnel Hill, GA-(WDEF-TV) The Heritage girls basketball team remained undefeated on the season after beating rival NW Whitfield 45-26. The Generals were up only seven points at halftime before pulling away for the win. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Chattanooga Mocs Mourn the Passing of Long Time Equipment Manager Mike Royster
item.description: (gomocs.com) The Chattanooga Mocs campus and community is saddened to share the passing of former equipment manager Mike Royster. item.title: LFO Edges Rival Ringgold 66-64
item.description: Fort Oglethorpe, GA-(WDEF-TV) In a battle of unbeatens on Friday, LFO defeated rival Ringgold 66-64. The Warriors enjoyed a 15-point lead in the first half before the Tigers fought back to make it close down the stretch. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Calhoun’s Cole Speer leads Georgia to SEC title over Alabama
item.description: ATLANTA (AP) — Gunner Stockton and Georgia finally put an end to Alabama’s mastery of the rivalry between Southeastern Conference powers. Stockton threw three touchdown passes as the third-ranked Bulldogs solidified their position for a first-round bye in the College Football Playoff and beat Alabama in the SEC championship game for the first time, pounding the 10th-ranked Crimson Tide 28-7 on Saturday....

item.title: Marion County quest for back-to-back state titles falls short
item.description: CHATTANOOGA, Tennessee (WDEF)- Huntingdon jumped out to a 20-0 lead early in the third quarter. Marion County added a fourth-quarter touchdown to cut into the lead, but it wasn’t enough to repeat as state champs. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
